title: Pontotoc girls beat Grenada 7–0, boys win 6–0 in home soccer sweep

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s varsity soccer teams sent Grenada home without a goal Tuesday. The girls won 7–0 in the first match and the boys followed with a 6–0 win. The Warriors scored 13 goals between the two games on their home field.

The girls matched the seven goals they scored against Ripley in their Nov. 3 home opener. Tuesday was their third shutout in five reported games, after the win over Ripley and a 2–0 win at Southaven. Grenada’s keeper was credited with 15 saves in Tuesday’s match.

For the boys, six goals marked their highest total in five reported games. They had scored three against Ripley, one at New Albany, one at Southaven and one against North Pontotoc. Their previous shutout was the 1–0 win at Southaven on Nov. 10.
Both Pontotoc schedules list Strayhorn at home Thursday, Nov. 19. The girls are scheduled for 5 p.m. and the boys for 7 p.m.
